description: Virtual Roads for the BioEnergy Atlas is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by South African Environmental Observation Network. Virtual roads representing theoretical paths [roads] starting every 1km apart (across South Africa) from areas where no roads exists to the closest road segment in South Africa's National Geo-spatial Information (NGI) 2019 road layer ( -- for use in the SAEON BioEnergy Atlas feasibility model. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher South African Environmental Observation Network. Its tags are HUMAN DIMENSIONS, Roads, South Africa. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
